## ⛔ Merged by the maintainer at the Tier H sitting, 2026-10-26 09:00Z (北京 17:00) — not before

This PR is **Tier H by size** (the whole objectui tree, ~2.6 M lines) and is the first of four merged in order at the sitting: this PR → 4a #25745 → PR B (objectstack#25697 item 6) → 4b PR 2 #25712, then the required-checks change (step 6). It stays draft until the seat says it is green; the seat never enqueues it. Reviewers: the GOVERNED_APPROVERS, requested when it leaves draft.

## What this PR is

objectui (objectstack-ai/objectui) becomes the `ui/` workspace of this repository, per the maintainer's D1 ruling (objectstack#25677: one repository, one fixed version group, the objectui repository archived as a migration notice).

1. **`git subtree add --prefix=ui`** of objectui `main` at its **frozen tip `9e1fe032866965c7cb0460cff2b6af09350236b7`** (objectui#13545, the final `.objectstack-sha` pin, pointing at objectstack `5e7cf63e71`). objectui `main` is frozen since 2026-10-25 15:40Z (freeze notice: objectstack#25752); nothing lands there after that commit. History is kept (no squash).
2. **Root workspace file.** pnpm v10 reads `overrides` and `patchedDependencies` from `pnpm-workspace.yaml` only, so objectui's `pnpm` field moves there: the qs / shell-quote / tmp / uuid floors, the single react line (19.3.0), the `@radix-ui/react-focus-scope@1.1.16` patch; the react-router override narrows to the 8.x line it fixes (objectui's react-router-dom 7.18 pins a 7.x react-router with no fixed version to force).
3. **Adaptation series (objectstack#25803, card J)** — one commit per gate or concern, each named in its message. Drop 1: every `@objectstack/*` range in the 32 ui manifests becomes `workspace:^`; `ui/` stops being a workspace root of its own (nested `pnpm-workspace.yaml` deleted, `pnpm` field and `preinstall` pin check removed, `turbo.json` parked as `turbo.objectui.json`); the ui root manifest drops its turbo-recursive scripts; `scripts/ui-import/splice-lockfile.mjs` carries objectui's lockfile resolutions into the merged lock. Drop 2 (root gates, ledgers, eslint ignore, skills move, the K1 scoping of `check:published-files`) follows in this PR before it leaves draft; the list is in `/mnt/project-files/d1-merge/out/cutover-adaptation/SERIES.md` and will be mirrored here.
4. **One lockfile.** `ui/pnpm-lock.yaml` is removed; the root lock is objectui's resolutions spliced in (`moved 0` against objectui's own lock at the splice), reconciled twice with `pnpm install --lockfile-only`, then `pnpm dedupe`; `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and `pnpm dedupe --check` exit 0. `ai` 7.0.118 and `@ai-sdk/react` 4.0.121 hold one copy each.

## What this PR does not do

- It does not touch `.github/workflows/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `docs/adr/**` or CODEOWNERS: the pin-gate retirement is PR B, the release lane is 4a #25745, the workflow port is 4b PR 2 #25712, the governance for `ui/` landed in #25732.
- It does not remove the `packages/console` pin field or its build switch (sub-issue 4).
- It does not conform the 39 `@object-ui` manifests to `check:published-files` (maintainer ruling K1: the gate is scoped off `ui/` here; aftercare objectstack#25753).

## Accepted red classes (procedure #25752, "Accepted red classes") and the bill

Anything red on this PR is read against `/mnt/project-files/d1-merge/out/5-cutover-bill-notes.md` (items 1–36). A red that is not on the bill stops the sitting until it is ruled.
